i have been given this task. Id like you to break the problem down into technical steps.


* Create an FHL research profile info sheet. Target audiences: RIMB class, FHL website, FHL community
   * Compile a spreadsheet of FHL research publications since the lab opened (including when it was called Puget Sound Biological Station and Puget Sound Marine Station). Reality-check it for false positives. 
   * Ideal data columns:
      * Author names
      * Publication year
      * Publication title
      * Publication type: peer-reviewed journal article, book chapter, book, report, editorial, letter, public dataset, news media…any other?
      * Friday Harbor Laboratories (or PSBS or PSMS) appears in which sections of the publication: author affiliation, main text, or both
      * Number of citations of each publication 
      * Anything else that seems important?
   * Graphically summarize patterns of # publications and # citations over time, by publication type, by FHL affiliation vs. main text + anything else that seems interesting
do all steps

Short messages while the census was being built: a progress check, signing in to the UW Libraries, Web of Science and Scopus (the Scopus sign-in failed), saving the exported files, and whether more help was needed that night.
